`api: mega-button-kinds` — Carbon's `secondary` is the fill and its `tertiary` the outline; MegaButton swaps them on purpose (the outline reads better beside a neutral primary) and has two red kinds, `danger` and `danger--secondary`.
`api: mega-button-key-command` — a visible key command on a button, shown with KeyboardShortcut and announced through `aria-keyshortcuts`. Carbon's Button has none.
`api: mega-button-icon-position` — the one icon may lead or trail the label. Carbon's Button only trails it.
`api: mega-button-danger-icon-only` — the two danger kinds are allowed icon-only. Carbon's IconButton has no danger kinds.

`api: mega-button-hide-tooltip` — an icon-only button can leave out its own tooltip when its group draws one shared tooltip (ChatInput's actions), so neighbours never show two at once. The label still names it, through `aria-label`. Carbon's IconButton always draws its own.
